explanation: HIF-driven induction (HIF-1alpha or HIF-2alpha, hypoxia response) of BNIP3 in the WWOX-deficient neural cells
level_of_chain: (i) transcript relation exists as non-neural DATO; (ii) protein and flux unknown; (iii) function in neurons protective in 41972676; (iv) damage, compensation or consequence undecided
DATO_INFERENZA_IPOTESI_status: (i) DATO non-neural; link in WWOX neural cells IPOTESI; reading as harm: IPOTESI (the engine H_HARM label is a conditional, not a finding)
prediction: BNIP3 co-moves with the other canonical HIF genes and falls on HIF1A and/or EPAS1 knockdown; HIF protein higher in KO than add-back at matched oxygen; mouse in vivo should show it too. Partly met: organoid shows HK2, ADM, BHLHE40, P4HA1, EGLN3 up (D01); not met: mouse P17 Bnip3 flat or lower (D03), HIF1A mRNA flat, neural BNIP3 rise is smaller than the five named genes, and in epileptic rat HIF-1alpha up with BNIP3 DOWN (D07). Added by audit: in the one neural in-vivo test (41324728) the authors read HIF-1alpha inhibition with higher BNIP3 as protective, and the abstract of 42323821 (abstract only) reports protective HIF1A-BNIP3 mitophagy in TBI neurons, so two neural sources read HIF inhibition or HIF1A-BNIP3 as protective; in 41324728 the KC7F2 arm is a pre-treatment 24 h before pilocarpine and BNIP3 rose before HIF-1alpha fell, which does not fit a simple HIF-dependent induction. EGR1, which the 42323821 abstract places upstream of HIF1A (represses its promoter), belongs here as an upstream regulator, not in E2.
minimum_public_datum_or_new_experiment: No public datum separates it. Public partials already held: the organoid co-signature (D01) and mouse P17 (D03). New experiment M2: HIF1A and EPAS1 knockdown (singly and together) in KO and isogenic add-back hNPC and neurons at 21, 5 and 1 percent O2, reading BNIP3 and BNIP3L protein plus EGLN3, ANKRD37, BHLHE40, ADM, P4HA1, with HIF-1alpha and HIF-2alpha protein by compartment. IPOTESI, public datum found by the audit with a cheap check: in GSE156243 (KO organoid) EGR1 log2 -1.04 (padj 0.038), BNIP3L -0.19, NDRG1, CA9 and PGK1 flat, EPAS1 +1.97, so the HIF pattern is only partial; cheap check: recompute these genes from the deposit counts and compare with the HIF-pattern genes of D01.
outcome_that_would_change_priority: If BNIP3 protein does not move with HIF1A/EPAS1 knockdown, E1 is dropped for BNIP3 and the HIF1A-to-BNIP3 premise leaves the proposals. If it does move AND mitophagy flux and survival fall when BNIP3 is lowered (M5), the HIF-lowering lever carries a harm signal and is deprioritised; if BNIP3 knockdown in KO cells improves survival or ROS, E1 becomes a conditional lever (H_HARM) worth a mechanism experiment.
pharmacological_action_that_would_make_s: Study HIF1A/EPAS1 genetic knockdown as the specificity reference, then a HIF-1alpha-lowering class only if BNIP3 follows HIF and BNIP3 lowering is benign or beneficial in KO cells.
action_that_could_be_opposite_or_harmful: Lowering HIF in cells where BNIP3 is a protective receptor (41972676: BNIP3 loss worsens OGD viability, ROS, membrane potential, apoptosis) would remove a protective response; a HIF-lowering compound that acts off-axis would be mistaken for BNIP3 reversal. Do not read BNIP3 up as damage by default.
control_required: Genetic HIF1A and EPAS1 knockdown arm before any compound; non-targeting control; isogenic add-back; both genotypes; oxygen series; compound arms with an inactive analogue; reading of BNIP3 is the IT7 readout gene so BNIP3 alone cannot validate a lever.
compound_or_class_named_by_sources: Named by the sources: KC7F2 (HIF-1 translation inhibitor, ICV in rat, 41324728, selectivity not shown there); PX-478, EZN-2968 and nitroglycerin appear only as engine entries (identity unresolved; no source of this package reads their action at BNIP3). Harness verifies chemical identities.
limit_preventing_candidacy: HIF protein never measured in a WWOX-deficient mammalian neural cell; BNIP3 protein unmeasured; the only direct neural HIF-inhibitor result (41324728) raised BNIP3 and is in a non-WWOX rat epilepsy model; no compound has been tested at BNIP3 in any WWOX system.
source_locator_depth: D01-D03, D06, D07, D11; 25012504 reused (complete read), 41324728 reused (Results and Fig 9), 41972676 partial

explanation: HIF-independent induction or stabilisation of BNIP3, including a consequence of mitochondrial or metabolic stress (FOXO3 transcription, mitochondrial-stress kinase signalling that stabilises BNIP3 protein such as Mst1/2, other drivers)
level_of_chain: (i) transcript driven by a factor other than HIF; (ii) protein level may be post-translational
DATO_INFERENZA_IPOTESI_status: DATO that BNIP3 protein is stabilised by Mst1/2 under mitochondrial stress in HEK cells (38443598, non-neural); FOXO3 to BNIP3 DATO in muscle and heart at abstract level; in WWOX neural cells IPOTESI. p53, E2F1 and NF-kB are named in the brief only: no source read here names them for BNIP3, so they are not adjudicated
prediction: BNIP3 protein is higher than the transcript change predicts, rises with mitochondrial stress markers, persists after HIF1A/EPAS1 knockdown, tracks FOXO3 activity or Mst1/2 activity; organoid FOXO3 1.19 times and EGLN2 0.89 times are small and do not discriminate.
minimum_public_datum_or_new_experiment: Public: none for neural WWOX cells. New experiment M3: BNIP3 protein half-life (translation block chase) and BNIP3 mRNA in KO versus add-back, with FOXO3 knockdown and a Mst1/2 inhibitor arm and with HIF1A/EPAS1 knockdown as the comparator.
outcome_that_would_change_priority: If BNIP3 persists after HIF knockdown and follows FOXO3 or Mst1/2, the HIF-lowering proposals are off-axis for BNIP3 and the question becomes the identity of the driver; if stabilisation is the mechanism, transcript-only seeds cannot be used for BNIP3.
pharmacological_action_that_would_make_s: Study the identified driver (genetic first), not HIF; at most a mitochondrial-stress reading (membrane potential, ROS) as the upstream question.
action_that_could_be_opposite_or_harmful: Mst1/2 knockdown lowers stress-induced BNIP3 and mitophagy in the source (HEK cells); the inhibitor XMU-MP-1 reduced loss of Mfn1, SDHB and Cox4 (a mitophagy proxy) and BNIP3 was not measured under the inhibitor, so inhibiting the driver may remove a protective response (not shown for BNIP3 itself); treating a stress-induced BNIP3 rise as something to reverse is unsupported.
control_required: Genetic knockdown of the named driver; matched oxygen and glucose; stress marker covariates; do not mistake a drug response for a defect in the drug target.
compound_or_class_named_by_sources: Named by sources: XMU-MP-1 (ATP-competitive Mst1/2 inhibitor, 38443598, HEK293, 5 uM bath, source fact; BNIP3 not measured under it). KC7F2 acts through 4E-BP and S6K per the source (41324728), which matters when it is read as a HIF tool. No compound for FOXO3 or EGR1 is named by a source read here.
limit_preventing_candidacy: No WWOX neural datum; the Mst1/2 BNIP3 steps are non-neural; FOXO3 rows are muscle and heart at abstract level; FOXO3, p53, E2F1 and NF-kB were NOT REACHED by this package (not "none exists": the audit found 41 PubMed records; abstract-level leads only, unread: 38043200 p53 in mouse brain/neurons and 34475505 FoxO3a in human brain).
